description: Put the pay ranges of one Ashby board side by side, one component at a time and one period at a time. Nothing is converted between currencies, summed across components or averaged: a third of the postings publish no range at all, and they are named rather than dropped.

board.description: A company name, or an Ashby board token.

component.description: One component at a time: a share of capital and a salary do not add up.

anyOf.description: A list of departments as the board spells them, one to 10 of them.

items.description: Departments as the board spells them.

anyOf.description: Departments as the board spells them.

interval.description: The period compared, 1 YEAR unless named. Postings on another period are listed apart, unconverted.

job_ids.description: A list of posting identifiers search_jobs returned, one to 50 of them.

query.description: Words to look for in the titles.

anyOf.description: A list of teams as the board spells them, one to 10 of them.

items.description: Teams as the board spells them.

anyOf.description: Teams as the board spells them.

name: compare_compensation

currencies_present.description: Named, because rows in different currencies do not rank against each other.

not_published.description: Postings whose company publishes no range, named rather than dropped.

other_intervals.description: Postings on another period, left unconverted.

tier_title.description: Which tier the amounts belong to, since one posting carries up to eight.

title: Compare published pay on one board
